title: Brex button
description: Flat vermilion buttons in three heights (36, 40 and 48px) that ease to a lighter orange over 0.5s on hover, plus the orange text link with a small arrow that nudges right and warms on hover.
notes: the link variant is the 'Learn more →' style used under every feature and card
uses the highlight token for the hover colour
name: brex-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: orange fill, lighter orange on hover · link: orange text with a trailing arrow

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 36px tall (header) · md: 40px (inside the email form) · lg: 48px (closing band)

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link (e.g. "submit" inside a form)
